catalog_name: Cymbal Warehouse 3-Tier Hierarchical Skills & Knowledge Catalog (OKF)

hierarchy_architecture.level_1: Root Domain Skill (High-level category entry point)
hierarchy_architecture.level_3: Operational Micro-Skill (Detailed SOP procedure and executable scripts)

suites.description: 3-tier workforce policy orchestrator covering employee leave, shift differentials, overtime, ergonomics, and OSHA clinic triage.

disciplines.description: Administers paid time off, medical certification rules, FMLA entitlements, and shift scheduling compliance.

micro_skills.description: Enforces the mandatory 3-consecutive-day sick note certification rule, continuous/intermittent FMLA eligibility (1,250 hours worked), and HIPAA-compliant physician note validation.

micro_skills.display_name: Shift Swap & Overtime Rest Period Approval
micro_skills.description: Verifies 8-hour mandatory rest intervals between consecutive shifts and collective bargaining overtime fairness.

disciplines.description: Calculates off-peak shift premiums, holiday multipliers, and hazardous zone hourly bonuses.

micro_skills.description: Applies +15% evening shift (16:00-00:00) and +22% graveyard/night shift (00:00-08:00) differential calculations to base hourly wages.
Applies 2.0x holiday multipliers and extreme temperature (cold chain freezer) hazard bonuses ($2.50/hr).

disciplines.description: Audits repetitive strain risks, NIOSH lifting standards, anti-fatigue rotations, and on-site clinic triage.

micro_skills.description: Calculates Recommended Weight Limits (RWL) per NIOSH lifting equation (max 51 lbs unassisted) and enforces 2-hour workstation rotation.

micro_skills.display_name: On-Site Clinic First Aid & OSHA 300 Triage
micro_skills.description: Guides emergency first-aid triage, automated nurse dispatch, and mandatory OSHA 300 log incident recording.

suites.description: 3-tier inventory discrepancy and velocity management suite covering cycle counts, high-velocity SKU-991, quarantine triage, and RFID triangulation.

disciplines.description: Executes ABC stratification cycle counting, shrinkage investigation, and quarantined tote release.

micro_skills.display_name: High-Velocity SKU-991 Perpetual Cycle Count Protocol
micro_skills.description: Executes ABC Class-A velocity cycle count procedures specifically for high-velocity items like SKU-991, performing automated WMS ledger reconciliation and variance root cause analysis.
Inspects damaged packaging, hazardous material holds, and QA release certifications for quarantined inventory.

disciplines.description: Leverages UHF RFID sensors and optical barcode cameras to locate misplaced high-value inventory.

micro_skills.display_name: RFID RSSI Rack Triangulation & Tote Localization
micro_skills.description: Calculates spatial coordinates of misplaced totes using Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) from fixed antenna arrays.
Regenerates high-density GS1-128 and 2D Datamatrix labels for degraded or unreadable packaging.

suites.description: 3-tier conveyor predictive maintenance suite covering motor vibration analysis, VFD thermal monitoring, ultrasonic belt tension, and splice wear.

disciplines.description: Analyzes motor vibration spectra, bearing fault harmonics, and variable frequency drive (VFD) thermal loads.

micro_skills.display_name: FFT Harmonic Peak & Bearing Degradation Analysis
micro_skills.description: Calculates Fast Fourier Transform frequency spectra to detect Ball Pass Frequency Outer (BPFO) and Inner (BPFI) raceway faults.
Monitors IGBT junction temperatures and calculates current derating to prevent motor winding insulation breakdown.

disciplines.description: Calibrates ultrasonic belt tension and tracks splice degradation across conveyor rollers.

micro_skills.display_name: Ultrasonic Belt Tension & Load Cell Calibration
micro_skills.description: Measures belt resonant vibration frequency to calibrate take-up carriage tension without stopping line.

micro_skills.display_name: Conveyor Belt Splice Wear & Joint Integrity
micro_skills.description: Inspects mechanical vulcanized splice seams via high-speed line scan cameras to prevent catastrophic belt parting.

suites.description: 3-tier environmental health and industrial safety suite covering Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), pneumatic residual dissipation, SDS hazmat response, and evacuation headcounts.

disciplines.description: Standardizes electrical and pneumatic zero-energy physical verification and multi-technician padlock protocols.

micro_skills.description: Verifies physical breaker lock placement, calibrated multimeter zero-voltage checks, and LOTO permit issuance.
Verifies discharge of stored kinetic energy in pneumatic pusher cylinders and pressure vessels.

disciplines.description: Directs chemical spill isolation, SDS neutralizer selection, and RFID muster point evacuation headcounts.

micro_skills.display_name: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Spill Containment & Neutralizer
micro_skills.description: Identifies chemical containment actions, neutralizing absorbents, and required PPE level (Level A-D) from SDS CAS numbers.

micro_skills.display_name: Muster Point Headcount & Missing Personnel Audit
micro_skills.description: Reconciles live badge RFID swipes at external assembly muster zones against active shift roster.

suites.description: 3-tier Automated Guided Vehicle coordination suite covering dynamic detour routing around stalled conveyors, LiDAR intersection arbitration, inductive opportunity charging, and payload balancing.

disciplines.description: Calculates graph detour routes around blocked conveyor lines and negotiates right-of-way at four-way intersections.

micro_skills.display_name: Conveyor Outage Dynamic Graph Bypass Routing
micro_skills.description: Computes A* shortest detour trajectories through secondary staging aisles when a conveyor zone is halted.
Arbitrates priority tokens between loaded AGVs, empty AGVs, and human-operated order pickers at blind aisle intersections.

disciplines.description: Dispatches opportunity charging to floor inductive pads and audits pallet center-of-gravity stabilization.

micro_skills.description: Routes AGVs with < 35% battery to available inductive floor pads during shift change or task idle cycles.
Calculates payload mass distribution to prevent AGV tip-over during high-speed turns.
